description_en: Query the list of objects to which a work has been shared, returning only the sharing configurations that are still within their validity period
description_zh: 查询作品被分享给哪些对象的列表，只返回仍然在有效期限内的分享配置
name: QueryShareList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the work. The works include data portal, dashboard, spreadsheet, self-service data retrieval, ad-hoc analysis, data entry, and data screen
parameters.help_zh: 作品ID。这里的作品包括数据门户、仪表板、电子表格、自助取数、即席分析、数据填报、数据大屏
parameters.name: report_id

Result.description_en: Returns the list of objects to which the work has been shared
Result.description_zh: 返回作品被分享给的对象列表

AuthPoint.description_en:
Sharing permissions. Possible values:

1: View only
3: View and export
AuthPoint.description_zh:
分享权限。取值范围：

1：仅查看
3：查看和导出

ExpireDate.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds indicating the expiration time of the authorization
ExpireDate.description_zh: 授权有效时间的毫秒级时间戳

ShareId.description_en: The ID of the sharing configuration

ShareToId.description_en:
The ID of the sharing target, which could be a user ID or a group ID in Quick BI.

When ShareToType=2 (all members within an organization), ShareToId is the organization ID
ShareToId.description_zh:
分享目标的ID，可能是在Quick BI的用户ID，可能是用户组ID。

当ShareToType=2（所有组织内的成员）的时候，ShareToId为组织ID

ShareToName.description_en: The name of the sharing target

ShareToType.description_en:
The type of sharing. Possible values:

0: User
1: Group
2: Organization
3: Space
ShareToType.description_zh:
分享类型。取值范围：

0：用户
1：用户组
2：组织
3：空间

ShareType.description_en:
The type of the shared work. The value range includes: 
dataProduct: Data Portal 
dashboard: Dashboard 
report: Spreadsheet 
dashboardOfflineQuery: Self-service Data Extraction 
ANALYSIS: Ad-hoc Analysis 
DATAFORM: Data Entry 
SCREEN: Data Visualization Screen
ShareType.description_zh:
被分享作品的类型。取值范围：
dataProduct：数据门户
dashboard：仪表板
report：电子表格
dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数
ANALYSIS：即席分析
DATAFORM：数据填报
SCREEN：数据大屏

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Possible values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
